title: FIPS ETag compatibility: accepted first wrapper, failed target test, and corrected probe

boundary_decision.rationale: Issue 1365 and PRs 1366 and 1410 form one continuous compatibility lineage: the first accepted wrapper left its capability probe unusable on the reported FIPS system, the target test overturned the closure, and the second PR changed that same probe.
boundary_decision.falsification: Split the lineage if an audited immutable patch or timestamped source shows that PR 1410 addressed a different failure path rather than the capability probe introduced by PR 1366.
